transport: Installed presentation opt-in: component module event kind 15, slot 0, empty payload
effect: The app module enables its history/detail composition. This event performs no HTTP, account mutation, command or persistence.
compatibility: Optional profile installed with iOS 1082. Hosts that do not send it retain the existing account presentation, including the desktop and world-agent sheet. A new runtime fingerprint isolates the new semantic navigation projection.
components: The existing component command stream carries the side, fixed-top and fixed-bottom groups. All actions return existing component IDs. Domain data uses unchanged account-history and environment-runtime codecs.
